verdict_reason: The paging spec matches the AC and the plants-frontend code (eight a page, GOV.UK pagination, Showing <shown> out of <total>), but the page restates the shared plants/addresses paging rule with a conditional Then instead of citing it.

todos.issue: REQ-PLANTS-CONTACT-SELECT-001 (line 13) and SCN-PLANTS-CONTACT-SELECT-001-A (lines 18-19) restate the picker paging rule that this PR gives its own home in plants/addresses REQ-PLANTS-ADDR-002 (SCN-002-A 'first eight are shown, with GOV.UK pagination', SCN-002-G 'eight or fewer ... no pagination'). The restatement is weaker than its owner: the Then is conditional ('pagination is offered only where the organisation holds more than eight') under a Given that does not fix how many addresses there are, so one scenario carries both AC branches and neither is a single observable case; and 'up to eight' drops the AC's 'the first 8'. openspec/config.yaml: 'Cross-cutting mechanisms (obligations, addresses ...) get their own capability, not scatter across screens' and 'One subject, one capability. Cross-reference owners'.
todos.fix: Must: the paging rule (eight a page, pagination only over eight, first page first) is stated once, in plants/addresses REQ-PLANTS-ADDR-002, and this page spec cites it rather than restating it with a conditional Then. One way: cut the paging clause from REQ-PLANTS-CONTACT-SELECT-001 down to 'paged as `plants/addresses` REQ-PLANTS-ADDR-002 says', and drop the pagination AND line from SCN-001-A so its Then reads 'it shows the first page of the addresses the organisation holds, reading "Showing <shown> out of <total> results" ...'; apply the same to the place-of-destination and consignor-select page specs so the three pickers read alike.
